concept.title: Shift lever
concept.shortdesc: Electric vehicles transmit the rotation of the motor to the wheel through the reducer.

li.p: Select the gear position by turning the shift lever.
For your safety, always depress the brake pedal while shifting to another gear.
Press P button to shift to P (Park).

note.p: To reduce the risk of serious injury or death:

li.p: Always check the surrounding areas near your vehicle for people, especially children, before shifting to D (Drive) or R (Reverse).

Before leaving the driver’s seat, always make sure the vehicle is in P (Park), then set the parking brake, and place the vehicle in OFF position. Unexpected and sudden vehicle movement can occur if these precautions are not followed.
